title: Meta to Build C$13 Billion Alberta Data Center, its First in Canada
key_facts: Meta said it will invest around US$10 billion (C$13 billion in Canadian headlines) in its first data center in Canada.
Site: Sturgeon County, Alberta; one gigawatt of power capacity, described as the power used by about 750,000 homes.
The site will run largely on natural-gas-fired power; Meta says it is funding the new generation, connected to Alberta's grid.
About 3,000 construction workers needed; 300 full-time jobs once complete.
Gary Demasi, Meta's vice president of data center development and strategy, said it will be Meta's largest data center outside the US.
quote_evidence: Meta Platforms will invest around $10 billion to build its first data center in Canada as the company expands its infrastructure to support its artificial intelligence ambitions.
The facility will require 3,000 construction workers, and once complete, will create 300 full-time jobs, Meta said in a statement on Wednesday.
why_it_matters_hint: Meta's biggest data center outside the US adds a large gas-powered AI site to Alberta's grid.
